name: gsm2computer
install:
[ ! -d '/agent/repos/gsm2computer' ] || cd '/agent/repos/gsm2computer' || exit $?
if [ -x scripts/cloud-agent-android-sdk.sh ]; then
  bash scripts/cloud-agent-android-sdk.sh
else
  test -x /opt/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb
  test -d /opt/android-sdk/platforms/android-34
  test -d /opt/android-sdk/system-images/android-34/google_apis/x86_64
fi
